Assertion: Algorithm "prioritizes Satisfaction" via end-of-watch signals and 1-5 star surveys; 1 star "suffocates" reach.
Evidence_Note: Official pages confirm satisfaction surveys and likes/dislikes/not-interested as inputs; star-scale reach suppression and the "good abandonment" taxonomy are not stated.
Audit_Use: Treat satisfaction as a real but unmeasured signal; never infer it for a video.

Assertion: Channels with <100k-impression-style "dead" status should be abandoned for a fresh email; YouTube treats every email differently.
Evidence_Note: Neither page mentions dead channels or account/email treatment; recommendations are described as personalised to viewers.
Audit_Use: Do not use; creator theory only.

Assertion: Mixing Shorts and long-form on one channel harms performance.
Evidence_Note: Official page says the system favors no particular format or video type; no channel-mixing penalty is stated.
Audit_Use: Do not penalise formats for mixing.

Assertion: Tags checklist (main keyword first tag etc.).
Evidence_Note: Official page calls tags minimally important (spelling variants).
Audit_Use: Never score tag use; titles/descriptions matter more.

Assertion: Algorithm ranks viewer curiosity gap, not how good the video is.
Evidence_Note: Official page lists clicks, skips, view duration, percentage viewed, surveys and likes as performance signals.
Audit_Use: Curiosity is a creative lens, not a ranking law.

Assertion: Upload sequencing / content chaining drives binge loops.
Evidence_Note: Official page says recommendations use videos commonly watched together and how much of a channel the viewer already watches; no required upload order.

Assertion: Views die after 24-48 hours; fixed reset windows.
Evidence_Note: Page states no reset intervals; reach shifts with topic popularity, competition and seasonality.
Audit_Use: Do not interpret age-based tiers as reset effects; K01 uses lifetime rate only.

Assertion: More boxes hit raises odds of going viral.
Evidence_Note: Page makes no guarantees; checklist itself says it is not about checking every box.
Not covered by the three starting pages.
